posts.name: zCAD AI
posts.tagline: AI 3D that creates real parts, not just shapes
posts.description: zCAD. AI is an AI-native platform for generating parametric 3D models, built for designers, makers and engineers. Describe a part or assembly in plain language, and zCAD. AI generates an editable, dimension-driven 3D model built on real CAD geometry, not a static mesh. • Complete assemblies from a single prompt, with mates between parts • Refine in plain language, or edit dimensions in a browser-based CAD editor • Export to STEP for use in any CAD tool

posts.name: myPip
posts.tagline: Vibe code, publish, and monetize games with AI
posts.description: MyPip turns your game ideas into playable games you can publish and monetize. Describe what you want to build, and AI brings it to life directly in your browser, no coding required. Create multiplayer experiences, add in-app purchases and ads, and take your games beyond the browser to reach more players. From your first idea to publishing and monetization, MyPip gives anyone the tools to become a game creator.

posts.name: 1Password for Agents
posts.tagline: Let AI agents sign in for you without seeing your passwords
posts.description: 1Password for Agents lets supported AI agents sign in to your accounts without ever seeing your passwords. When an agent hits a login, it asks 1Password. You approve or deny on your own device, and 1Password fills the password or one-time code directly. Connecting an agent doesn’t open your whole vault. Included in Individual and Family plans, with Meta Muse and Grok Bot rolling out and a waitlist.

posts.name: AgentValley
posts.tagline: Every Claude Code agent, at a glance, in your Mac's notch
posts.description: It sits in your MacBook's notch. Every Claude Code session gets a card, every sub-agent gets a row, and each one has a little pixel programmer. You see who's working, on which model, and who's waiting on you. Free and open source.

posts.name: LinkIntel
posts.tagline: Post insights delivered direct to your AI
posts.description: Your AI already drafts your X posts, but it has never seen how they performed. LinkIntel fixes that. Connect X once and it records how your recent posts do, every day. It also reads X's open-source ranking weights daily and links every change to its GitHub commit. Add one URL to Claude, ChatGPT, or your favorite agent harness and ask for a brief: your next draft starts from what actually worked for you

posts.name: Canva Craft
posts.tagline: Turn prompts into design-ready images you can edit
posts.description: Canva Craft is Canva’s first in-house image model, built for marketers, creators and designers who need images that work as designs, not just pictures. Unlike models trained mostly on photos that render pixels straight from a prompt, Craft learned from millions of Canva templates and plans the composition first, then renders it at 2K in 30+ aspect ratios. Expect legible text in 55 languages, precise placement and outputs you can split into editable layers. Live in Canva today, plus API.

posts.name: Many Displays
posts.tagline: Zero clicks: windows back after sleep, unlock or replugging
posts.description: Nothing to save, no layouts to name, nothing to click. Many Displays quietly remembers where every window lives (display, position, size) and puts everything back on its own when your Mac wakes, unlocks or reconnects its monitors. Grant Accessibility once and forget it's there. Built for identical monitors that macOS keeps swapping: it tells them apart, even by the port they're plugged into. No cloud, no account. $19 one-time, 14-day free trial.

posts.name: Penta
posts.tagline: A ’90s 5-disc CD changer on iPhone Duo
posts.description: Penta turns your iPhone, iPad or iPhone Duo into a ’90s 5-disc CD changer for your Apple Music library. Every click, whir and tray motor is recorded from a real CD changer. On iPhone Duo the phone is the jewel case: close it and you’re holding the album, open it and the case opens with it, then drop the disc into the carousel. Hold it upright for a CD wallet over the tray that animates open and closed. Free, with an optional one-time Pro unlock for the real printed CD art.

posts.name: Byter
posts.tagline: Know exactly how much data you use, on every network
posts.description: Byter shows how much internet data you use, and where. It tracks usage separately for every Wi‑Fi network, phone hotspot and wired connection, so you know exactly what your hotspot bundle went on. You also get live speed, a one-click speed test, daily-to-yearly charts, and gentle alerts when usage spikes. Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads. Available now for Mac, Windows coming soon, in 11 languages.

posts.name: Basedash Scheduled CSV Exports
posts.tagline: Ask once. Get a fresh CSV in Slack or email every week.
posts.description: Basedash automations can now send CSV exports. Write it into the instructions — "send a CSV of last week's new signups every Monday" — and each run builds the file from your data. In Slack, the CSV is attached in the message's thread; emails and the automation's run history get a Download CSV link. Downloads go through Basedash, so recipients need access to the automation to open them. Ask for it once. Get the CSV every week.

posts.name: sideOS.ai
posts.tagline: Local AI for dictation, meetings, background tasks and more
posts.description: sideOS lives in your Mac’s notch. Hold Control + Option, say what you want, let go! It reads your screen, opens apps, clicks, types and tells you when it’s done. Run it fully offline local models or use your own Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or Grok key.

posts.name: How It Went
posts.tagline: Your route, photos and clips as a short film
posts.description: Turns one ride or a whole trip into a short film from the GPS track, photos and clips you already have. Your track draws itself across a tilted map, each photo appears where you took it, and clips play where they were shot. Pick rides from Strava or bring Garmin FIT and GPX files. Several days merge into one film, rest days included. Fix a wrong camera clock once and every shot from it moves. Out comes an MP4, 9:16 or 16:9, assembled and encoded on your iPhone, Android phone or Mac.

posts.name: Shedi
posts.tagline: Get back the space Xcode, Docker and node_modules ate
posts.description: The honest Mac cleaner. Shedi finds what Xcode, Docker, node_modules and 20+ package managers left on your Mac, says what each item is and whether it comes back, and cleans only what you pick. Everything goes to the Trash first. Pay once.

posts.name: River Writer
posts.tagline: A quiet Mac app for screenplays, stage plays and novels
posts.description: River Writer is a free Mac app for screenplays, stage plays and novels. You write plain text (.fountain ormd) and a live preview shows the formatted, print-ready pages beside it: Screenplay, Multi-cam, Stage Play or Manuscript. Git versioning is built in, so you can commit drafts, restore files and try an alternate ending on a branch. Outline, scratchpad and todos live as plain files in your project. No accounts, cloud, telemetry or AI; it makes no network connections. Open source (MIT).

posts.name: Laylight
posts.tagline: Get the full picture
posts.description: Laylight connects your company’s existing tools so you can see what’s happening across your business in one place. It helps teams save time by automating repetitive tasks, coordinating their work and giving management greater visibility into what’s going on.

posts.name: Fluxix
posts.tagline: Control what your AI agents can access, run, and spend
posts.description: AI agents can call APIs, access databases, and move money. But one wrong action can cause serious damage. Fluxix puts a safety layer between your agents and your systems, checking every action before it happens. Set rules in plain English, block risky operations, require human approval, and protect sensitive data. Every decision is logged, so you stay in control without slowing your agents down.

posts.name: Surveys in Claude and ChatGPT
posts.tagline: Build surveys in Claude and ChatGPT, keep answers private
posts.description: Connect BlockSurvey to Claude, Claude Code or ChatGPT. Describe the survey you need and get a live link back in the same chat. Change questions by asking. Responses stay end-to-end encrypted, so your AI assistant never sees them.

posts.name: gethome
posts.tagline: Smart home on a hub you own, with AI that writes the rules
posts.description: Run your home from a native iPhone app on a hub you own — a small computer such as a Raspberry Pi, on your own Wi-Fi. Pair Zigbee and Matter devices, ask the assistant, and describe a rule for an AI agent to write. AI runs on your own Anthropic or OpenAI key.

posts.name: GlossPage: Translate and Read
posts.tagline: Translate manga, comics, books, PDFs
posts.description: Translate photos, books, manga and PDFs. Read both languages together. Capture and translate text in any app with Back Tap or the Action Button, even text you can’t copy.

posts.name: CombienVautMonLogement
posts.tagline: Free AI home valuations. No signup. No spam.
posts.description: Discover your home's estimated value in France with AI, real estate transaction data and interactive maps. No account, no personal details, no unwanted calls. Explore local property prices, market trends and free tools. Connect with an advisor only when you choose.

posts.name: Kept
posts.tagline: Turn ideas into action. AI planner: tasks, notes, calendar
posts.description: I built what I wish Notion, Craft Notes, and Things 3 felt like together. What makes this app different from the many todo apps on product hunt: - Goal tracking makes the app built around helping you actually achieve your productive goals, rather than making you do the work of being organized yourself. - Todos use Apple Intelligence on device to auto sort tasks into areas that you define [making them easily searchable later] - Integrated calendar, tasks, and notes work and sync on iPhone, Mac.

posts.name: Daily Simmer
posts.tagline: Save any recipe, make it yours, then plan, shop and cook
posts.description: Paste a recipe link or an Instagram, TikTok, Facebook or YouTube post and get a clean recipe with ingredients, steps, servings and a link to its source. Snap a recipe card or start from an idea. Ask the AI sous chef for a swap and approve every change before it saves. Moving from Paprika, CookBook, Flavorish, Mr. Cook or Recipe Keeper? Bring your recipes along. Then plan the week, shop from one list and cook step by step. Free to start, in any browser.

posts.name: Prompt Deck
posts.tagline: Your coding agents' prompts, memory files and chat history
posts.description: I change coding agents most weeks, and each one keeps its own memory file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md) and stores its slash commands and chat history in a different folder and format. Prompt Deck is a native SwiftUI app that finds all of that on your disk and puts it in one window: prompts that become slash commands, every memory file in one list, and searchable sessions from 11 coding agents. Pro adds Dreams and Insights. Nothing to import, no account.

posts.name: Looper
posts.tagline: If Grok Bot drove business metrics up and was Open Source
posts.description: An AI hire for one number you care about. It works daily in Gmail, GitHub, Search Console and the rest, asks your team before anything goes out, and gets a 1:1 every two weeks to improve. Open source. Runs free on the ChatGPT or Grok plan you already pay for.

posts.name: Proof
posts.tagline: Design pro websites from what 400+ real sites do best
posts.description: AI guesses what a good page looks like. Proof learned it from 400+ real product pages. One short brief → the right sections, in the right order, in your brand. It self-checks and never invents facts.

posts.name: Korture Now: Focus App Blocker
posts.tagline: Stop scrolling, do the one thing you want
posts.description: Your phone has too many distractions. Korture Now helps you keep your focus. The whole app is two screens. Now: write the one thing you will do and press Start. Drift: everything else. Tasks for later, finished tasks, settings. While you focus, the apps you set aside stay blocked. Open one anyway and you see your own words. No schedules, streaks or scores. You decide when you are done. No account. Korture never sends your tasks anywhere. Seven starts free, then pay once. No subscription.

posts.name: Spilr
posts.tagline: Start by hearing yourself: an AI journal that asks back
posts.description: Write or talk for two minutes a day. After three entries, Spilr starts building a mirror from your own words: what sets you off, the loops you repeat, and the strengths you overlook. Every insight shows the entries behind it, and you can correct it.

posts.name: Calendar Assistant
posts.tagline: Your calendar, just ask: plan by chat, voice or photo
posts.description: Most calendar apps make you fill in forms. Calendar Assistant lets you just say it: “Lunch with Sara Friday at 1” and it’s in Google Calendar or Outlook. What stands out: - Snap a photo of an invitation or ticket: date, time and place are added - Any language or dialect, Arabic and Derja included, right to left - Move, recolor or plan your week in one sentence - Several Google and Outlook accounts together - Chrome extension, Windows app and phone.

posts.name: TaskPocket
posts.tagline: Organize your life, not your to-do app
posts.description: My favorite to-do app only ran on Apple devices, and work gave me a Windows laptop. Everything else I tried was built for teams or pushed AI, so I built TaskPocket: inbox, today, and projects grouped into areas, with dates and repeats typed in plain words. It runs in any browser and on iPhone, where it works offline. No AI inside, but there's a public API and an MCP server, so you can connect the Claude or ChatGPT you already pay for. The free plan has unlimited tasks.

posts.name: FontMeter
posts.tagline: Font sizes, real fonts and contrast, right on the page
posts.description: FontMeter labels every text style on any page and shows the fonts that really render, the type scale and contrast. Inspect spacing, measure and pick colors without opening DevTools. Free, runs locally, and you can try every tool on fontmeter.dev first.

posts.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
posts.tagline: Moonshot’s 3T-class model for coding, 3D and finance
posts.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro is Moonshot’s most capable 3T-class model, a post-trained update to K3 with a 1M-token context. Moonshot reports gains in coding, 3D modeling, finance and agentic tasks, including 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0. A Highspeed version runs 2-3x faster. It’s live on Kimi.ai, the apps, Kimi Code and the API. Moonshot says open weights are due by November 4, 2026.

posts.name: MindChess
posts.tagline: Your daily chess gym and study companion
posts.description: MindChess is a daily chess gym for iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo and Mac: 60-second drills for board vision, memory and calculation. Version 1.3 adds a repertoire trainer with spaced repetition, a diagram scanner, a chess clock and Stockfish 19 offline (Pro).

posts.name: Insta360 Mic
posts.tagline: A wireless mic with customizable E-Ink and pro audio
posts.description: Insta360 Mic is a wireless microphone designed for creators who want professional audio with a personal touch. Customize its E-Ink display with your logo or artwork, record 32-bit float audio to your own microSD card, and capture clear voices with AI noise cancellation. It supports up to four transmitters, connects directly to compatible Insta360 cameras, and delivers up to 34 hours of battery life with the charging case.

posts.name: Stuvelo
posts.tagline: The CRM built for filmmakers
posts.description: The CRM and project workspace built for filmmakers and creative studios. Manage clients, projects, invoices, and deliverables in one place.

posts.name: Gugu
posts.tagline: Send it a reel. It remembers what was in it.
posts.description: Send any Instagram reel to Gugu and it sorts the films, recipes, cafés and products into a stash you'll actually use. It's free.

posts.name: Pitlane
posts.tagline: Speed up iOS Simulators without Xcode
posts.description: Many of us work on multiple apps at a time, and hardware occasionally gets too slow, especially with a bunch of Xcode windows and simulators open. With Pitlane you can select, build, run and debug your projects without opening Xcode at all. It also switches off the background services your app never calls, so hundreds of background processes drop to dozens and each simulator needs far less memory. A local API lets your agents build, read the errors, fix and rebuild without you.

posts.name: Browser Toys
posts.tagline: Free browser games, fast loading, no ads
posts.description: I made 100 games in 100 days (using AI of course), now you can play them for free, no ads.

posts.name: SEO X-Ray & Audit Pro
posts.tagline: 1-click on-page SEO audits & white-label client PDF reports
posts.description: Advanced SEO Audit, Content Ripper, Schema Generator, Link Checker & Competitor Spy with White-Label PDF Reports.

posts.name: Kaeso
posts.tagline: A fast, open-source AI gateway built in Rust
posts.description: Kaeso is an open-source AI gateway you run yourself, so applications talk to one API while you keep provider keys, routing, and usage under your control.

posts.name: YoFluent
posts.tagline: Practise speaking English with an AI tutor
posts.description: Have real voice conversations with friendly AI tutors, then get scored on pronunciation, fluency, grammar and vocabulary. Try it free for 3 days.

posts.name: YoFluent
posts.tagline: Practise speaking English with an AI tutor
posts.description: Have real voice conversations with friendly AI tutors, then get scored on pronunciation, fluency, grammar and vocabulary. Try it free for 3 days.

posts.name: Eventograph
posts.tagline: Collect everyone's event photos & videos in one album
posts.description: Create a shared album in one tap and share the link or QR code. Guests upload photos & videos in original quality straight from their browser: no app, no account, no ads. 5GB free, hosted in the EU, and the album deletes itself after 15 days.

posts.name: ArcPace
posts.tagline: Find your best hour to run, scored for the weather
posts.description: ArcPace scores the weather every hour 0–100 for running, from temperature, dew point, wind and rain, and shows what it will do to your pace. You no longer have to do mental math, or constantly monitor the stock weather app to plan your runs. Glanceable views of saved running available windows, forecasts, and breakdown of every climate factors that affect how the run feels. Connect Apple Health and each past run gets a weather verdict and what the conditions cost you. Free on iOS, no account!

posts.name: Snipp
posts.tagline: Screenshot and clip sharing that blurs your personal info
posts.description: Share screenshots and clips with one link. Edit them in a free browser editor, no account needed. Blur personal info yourself, ask Snippy, or turn on Blur Personal Info and it happens on upload. Works with ShareX, XerahS and Discord.

posts.name: HexaFloww
posts.tagline: AI-native marketing automation
posts.description: HexaFloww is an AI-powered marketing platform for businesses and agencies. Manage WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook messages in one inbox with AI replies trained on your business data. Run WhatsApp campaigns, bookings, social scheduling, email automation, SEO/AEO/GEO audits and Google review management-all in one place. Agencies can manage multiple clients from a single login.

posts.name: Liite
posts.tagline: The lightest way to put a page online.
posts.description: Claim liite.co/yourname and build a link-in-bio page from blocks, or upload HTML, a zip or a PDF and get a live link at yourname.liite.site. Free to start.

posts.name: VibeDoctor.io
posts.tagline: Security and performance checks for vibe-coded apps
posts.description: Apps built with Claude Code, Cursor or Codex run and look finished, but nobody has read what the agent wrote. Paste one line into your agent and it checks its own code as it writes. Every scan covers security (secrets, auth, packages) and code health, with one ranked report in under 2 minutes. Vibe X-Ray sends only the files a change touches, so prompts use fewer tokens. Every push is checked, and your live site is watched for speed on a phone and uptime around the clock.

posts.name: GoSprinta
posts.tagline: Race week, done right.
posts.description: Sprinta runs villa retreats during race week for amateur endurance athletes. Marathons, Hyrox and IM are booming and social. Yet a race trip usually means basic, overpriced hotels and crowded restaurants, doing it all yourself, and nobody to share it with. Sprinta turns ordinary race trips into extraordinary retreats: a curated villa, a crew that handles everything, and a community of 10 athletes. Each retreat includes a coach, physio, chef, race logistics, transfers + a film of the whole stay.

posts.name: Linkoku
posts.tagline: A connection game for 1–4 players
posts.description: A connection game for 1–4 players. Play solo against AI or with friends on one device. Connect five tiles in your color to win. Free to play, offline, with no ads.

posts.name: Points Daily Kids
posts.tagline: A simple, fun way for kids to build good habits
posts.description: Turn daily routines into good habits with tasks, points, and family-chosen rewards. Bright colors, animations, and sounds make it fun for kids. Simple controls and AI-assisted editing make it easy for parents. Available on iPhone and iPad.

posts.name: PM Interview Drills by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: Practise PM interview questions with instant AI feedback
posts.description: Quick PM interview drills: pick a question by type, company or difficulty, answer it, and get AI feedback on your thinking in seconds. Mock interviews, resume review, the question bank, portfolios and interview experiences all live in one prep hub. Try a drill without signing up.

posts.name: Poker Night Clock
posts.tagline: Free blinds timer for home poker tournaments
posts.description: Most poker clocks want an account, a subscription, or a laptop at the table. This one runs in your browser with no sign-up, works offline, and is ready in about a minute. Enter players and how long you want to play, and it builds the blind structure for you. [Rebuys, breaks, and payouts included.] Pro is $19.99 once, not monthly. It lets you run the game from your phone while the clock shows on the TV.

posts.name: Wisp by Elsewhere
posts.tagline: Discover indie games in Steam Next Fest
posts.description: Swipe through Steam's demos. It learns your taste as you go. Unofficial; not affiliated with Valve.

posts.name: Melodic Metronome
posts.tagline: Keep time with tap tempo, accents, and time signatures
posts.description: Keep the pulse clear while you practice. Set tempo quickly or tap it in, choose a time signature and accents, and follow the visual beat feedback. Melodic Metronome is built for timing drills, rehearsals and teaching, with strong output for situations where a quiet click is easy to lose. Use the full app free in your browser on phone, tablet or desktop. Optional Ad-Free access removes cross-app recommendations. Also available on Android.

posts.name: FillMatic
posts.tagline: Form Filler Extension for Realistic Test Data
posts.description: FillMatic is a browser extension that fills web forms with realistic, locale-aware fake data, reusable Actions, Profiles, and Recipes for developers and testers.

posts.name: Osmo: Science News for Kids
posts.tagline: STEM News Curated for Genius Kids
posts.description: A daily dose of STEM for curious kids aged 5 to 14. Osmo turns real science news from NASA, ESA and MIT into 5 short stories a day at 3 reading levels, each checked by a person. Read-aloud, a quiz and free worksheets.

posts.description: Transcribes any podcast on your Mac, names each speaker, writes a summary and answers your questions with quotes.

posts.description: bored.kids is a directory of apps, games and online activities for kids 2–14. Pick an age and an interest, read plain-spoken notes on what kids do in each one, and save a shortlist in your browser with no account. Four age bands and 16 interests, from early learning to chess and typing. Discover has guides built around questions kids ask, and Collections group listings by theme.

posts.description: A private stress tracker with a quick reset after every check-in. Version 2.5 is built for iPhone Duo: every screen fits open or closed, and three new experiences use the hinge, like folding the phone shut to close the book on a worry.

posts.tagline: The AI Operating System
posts.description: One chat, one email, one coding environment. One AI harness.

posts.name: Rewritly
posts.tagline: Your AI writing assistant for every app, Mac and Windows
posts.description: Rewritly is an AI writing assistant that works where you type: Gmail, Slack, Notion, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Word and more. On Mac and Windows now, iOS in App Store review. One plan covers all three. 7-day free trial. Code LAUNCH20: 20% off.

One link plays ten game styles (platformer, kart racer, escape room, quest and more) with the same cast in each and a leaderboard for every one. No download, plays on any device. Free to make with demo characters; turning your own photos into characters starts at £3.49 a month.

posts.name: ReadiBean
posts.tagline: Build your family's paper-book library and reading habit
posts.description: ReadiBean helps families with kids 0–12 build a reading habit around real paper books. Scan a book, put the phone away, and read together. Every book joins your Family library, with storytime voice recordings, personalized picks from cultures worldwide, and magical worlds that come alive as you read. We’re psychology researchers and parents of two. We built it on what actually helps kids keep reading. Earn up to $100 a year in book cards, our thank-you for reading together.

posts.name: MedBrains
posts.tagline: Hospital management software for Indian hospitals
posts.description: MedBrains is hospital management software (HIMS) built for Indian hospitals and clinics. OPD, IPD, lab, radiology, pharmacy, GST billing and insurance/TPA all work from one patient record, so nothing is typed twice. What stands out: ABHA linking at registration, Schedule H/H1/X and NDPS rules enforced at the pharmacy counter, live token boards for waiting rooms, and native iOS and Android apps for staff and patients. Run it in our cloud or on your own servers. Switch on only what you use.

posts.tagline: A private, offline period and symptom diary. No account.
posts.description: Luma is a simple period and symptom diary that keeps your data on your phone. Log bleeding, pain, mood and symptoms in a few taps, add a note, and see your history on a calendar. Export a PDF or CSV for a date range to share with your doctor, with personal notes left out by default. The diary is encrypted on the device, works offline and needs no account. Luma records what you log; it doesn't predict ovulation or fertile days.

posts.name: GoResume
posts.tagline: Speak your résumé in any language, tailor it to any job
posts.description: GoResume is a free AI resume builder used by 1M+ job seekers. Speak your story in any language (Malayalam, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Hindi…) or type it, and the AI drafts an English resume in under a minute. 99 ATS-friendly templates, a job-description tailor with match score and missing keywords, AI headshots from selfies, and a live goresume.io/u/you page that updates as you edit. Free to build and share; pay only for PDFs.

posts.name: TidyFrame
posts.tagline: Snap Mac windows and restore whole setups in one shortcut
posts.description: TidyFrame is a tiny Mac menu bar app that snaps windows to halves, thirds or your own positions, and saves whole setups as Workspaces you bring back with one shortcut. Unlike most snapping apps, it remembers your whole layout, not just one window. No account, no tracking, 34 languages. 7-day free trial, then $4.99 once. Launch week: 30% off with code LAUNCH30.

posts.name: JemBooth
posts.tagline: Photo booth strips on your phone, now with Halloween
posts.description: JemBooth turns your phone into a photo booth. Shoot a strip with a countdown or use your own photos, pick one of 21 designed strips or 100 layouts, add filters and frames, and save print-ready 2x6 and 4x6 strips. New: 8 Halloween strips.

posts.name: Unpixel
posts.tagline: Stop retyping text from videos, scans and screen shares
posts.description: Unpixel is a Mac menu bar app that copies text from anything on your screen. Press ⇧⌘2, drag over a video, screen share, scanned PDF or image, and the text is on your clipboard — recognized on-device by Apple’s Vision framework. Captured images are never saved or uploaded, and there’s no account. It also reads QR codes and pastes tables as tables. One-time purchase from $5.99, no subscription, every 1.x update included.

posts.name: Digital Diamond
posts.tagline: Premium All-in-One Online Web Utilities
posts.description: Fast, free web utility to download TikTok videos (no watermark) and Instagram Reels in 1080p high quality. Includes VIP tools for batch downloads, OCR text extraction, image compression, and custom QR codes.

posts.name: Camera M 10 - Pro Camera
posts.tagline: RAW, ProRAW, Bracket, & Macro
posts.description: Camera M is a professional manual camera app designed to do one thing exceptionally well — help you capture beautiful photos at the highest possible quality with powerful, precise manual controls akin to a DSLR. Now with iPhone 18 Pro variable aperture control support. Also support for new aperture-priority and shutter-priority modes. And more...

posts.name: Squat for Mac
posts.tagline: Turn AI work breaks into squat breaks.
posts.description: The official website for Squat, a Mac app that turns breaks during AI work into opportunities to move. Explore its features, follow the first-launch guide, download the free preview, or sign up to be

posts.name: StemOverflow
posts.tagline: Your personal Olympiad coach, available 24/7
posts.description: One-on-one AI guidance to understand the concepts, work through difficult problems and get unstuck. Maths Olympiads. Physics Olympiads. Informatics Olympiads.

posts.name: Refind — Find What You Found Before
posts.tagline: A fast, offline-first personal bookmark
posts.description: A fast, offline-first personal bookmark and link organizer with instant share-to-save, tag-based organization, and smart search.

posts.name: FeeSathi
posts.tagline: Fee tracker with WhatsApp reminders for tuition teachers
posts.description: FeeSathi helps tuition teachers see who owes fees, mark payments in one tap, and send WhatsApp reminders with the exact amount, which you review and send yourself. Track attendance, send receipts, and import or export Excel files.

posts.name: Revenue First Analytics for WooCommerce
posts.tagline: Analytics that shows which traffic brings revenue.
posts.description: Self-hosted, privacy-first WooCommerce analytics that puts sales before pageviews. Every WooCommerce order is attributed to the channel, campaign and landing page that brought the buyer, and all data stays in your own WordPress database. Features: * Revenue by channel, campaign, landing page and country * Funnels and goals show where shoppers drop off * Cookieless privacy mode, no banner required * Works with WooCommerce and Easy Digital Downloads * Includes MCP and Direct developer support

posts.name: Measurebase
posts.tagline: The best base for your server-side tracking + monitoring
posts.description: Server-side tracking that runs itself. Measurebase hosts your server container in the EU. Advanced power-ups ensure maximum data quality. Our dashboard offers realtime insights. Our monitoring system audits your entire setup every day including code crawls and connections with GTM, GA4 and your ad platforms. Alerts make sure your tracking never breaks silently. Issues can be fixed in one click. With the MCP you can ask about and improve your tracking setup through your favorite LLM.

posts.name: YouTube Pop Out Player - Floaty
posts.tagline: Pop out YouTube with speed, loop and real controls
posts.description: Floaty pops any YouTube video into a small always-on-top window, with the controls Chrome's picture-in-picture is missing: 0.5–3× speed, A-B loop, 10s skip, playlist next/prev and volume. Alt+P to start. No account, no tracking, 52 languages.

posts.name: Audio Clipper
posts.tagline: Cut and trim MP3 in your browser, nothing gets uploaded
posts.description: Open an audio file, drag the two handles across the waveform, and export just the part you need as MP3 or WAV. Decoding and encoding run on your own computer, so nothing is uploaded, there is no account to create, and the clip has no watermark.

posts.name: CADstart
posts.tagline: Learn 2D CAD in your browser, step by step
posts.description: CADstart pairs a browser-based 2D CAD workspace with guided beginner lessons and drawing exercises. Practice coordinates, snaps, dimensions, layers, and architectural/civil drafting basics—without installing separate CAD software. Try the free demo.

posts.name: poddub
posts.tagline: Hear what your company ships
posts.description: poddub turns what your company ships into a short podcast episode. Paste release notes, a memo or an agent's summary, approve the script, and your team hears it in the app or any podcast app.

posts.name: Bascule: Real Live Translator
posts.tagline: A real interpreter for two – speak, tilt, translated
posts.description: Bascule turns your iPhone into a real interpreter for two. Hold the phone between you: each person reads their own half of the screen, and one tilt hands the conversation over. What you just said is translated and read aloud on the other side. No buttons, no passing the phone back and forth, no awkward silence while someone figures out an app. It adapts to natural pauses, works offline, and keeps notes and summaries of your conversation. Free, with Bascule+ for smarter AI translation.

posts.name: Earshot
posts.tagline: Earshot turns a spare phone into a listener for your home
posts.description: Earshot turns a spare phone into a listener for your home. When it hears the smoke alarm, the doorbell, the baby or a sound you describe in your own words, everyone in your household gets an alert, wherever they are. Audio never leaves the phone.

posts.name: EM Keep
posts.tagline: WhatsApp conversations, resurfaced on this day every year
posts.description: WhatsApp keeps all the messages you've shared buried under years of newer chats. The first texts from when you started dating, the voice of someone you miss. EM brings them back. Upload a chat and each day you'll find the messages and voice notes you shared on the date in past years, in a small stack of cards you swipe through, like an old photo album. Encrypted before it leaves your device. Only you can read your messages. For grief, love and the chats you're not ready to lose.

posts.name: LaunchList
posts.tagline: A weekly launch platform for AI builders
posts.description: LaunchList is a community-driven launch platform for AI and superintelligence builders. Discover new projects, share what you're building, and let the community vote for the products worth watching. A new way for ambitious makers to get discovered.

posts.name: Revive My Reputation
posts.tagline: Control what people see when they Google you
posts.description: Build a stronger online presence with positive, search-optimised content that helps move unwanted reviews, articles, and outdated results off page one. Track your progress through one simple dashboard.

posts.name: Onlymails
posts.tagline: Find email inspiration from the best ecommerce brands
posts.description: Onlymails is where you go when you need your next email idea. Browse real campaigns and flows from the best ecommerce brands, from welcome series to win-back, and filter them by niche, offer or season. Every email opens in full, already tagged. Follow the brands you keep an eye on to see their new emails as they land, then save the best ones to folders you can share.

posts.name: Vytality Fitness
posts.tagline: Strength training for 40+ — weekly goals, not daily streaks
posts.description: Strength training built on a weekly budget instead of a daily streak — miss a day and the week still counts. An AI coach plans each session around your equipment, your injuries and how the last one felt. Built for people over 40. Free while we are in beta.

posts.name: Gushi
posts.tagline: Learn Chinese for the new HSK 3.0, on phone and laptop
posts.description: The Chinese exam changed: the new HSK 3.0 has nine levels and 11,000 words. Gushi covers all nine, in English, German, Spanish and French. Every character comes with its tone, its parts, a story that holds it and where its shape came from. Spaced repetition decides what comes back and when. Reading, listening, speaking, writing and mock exams in one app, on phone and laptop. And language schools can see how their students are doing on the Teaching Platform.
